author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete the following terms:

- [x] 1. L-asparagine biosynthetic process from L-cysteine (GO:0019267)
- [ ] 2. L-asparagine biosynthetic process from oxaloacetate (GO:0019266)
- [x] 3. lysine biosynthetic process via aminoadipic acid (GO:0019878)
- [x] 4. lysine biosynthetic process via diaminopimelate (GO:0009089)
- [x] 5. lysine biosynthetic process via alpha-aminoadipate and N2-acetyl-alpha-aminoadipate | GO:0051976
- [x] 6. lysine biosynthetic process via alpha-aminoadipate and saccharopine | GO:0051975
- [x] 7. lysine biosynthetic process via diaminopimelate and L-2-acetamido-6-oxoheptanedioate | GO:0033360
- [ ] 8. lysine biosynthetic process via diaminopimelate and N-succinyl-2-amino-6-ketopimelate | GO:0033359
- [ ] 9. lysine biosynthetic process via diaminopimelate, dehydrogenase pathway | GO:0033361
- [ ] 10. lysine biosynthetic process via diaminopimelate, diaminopimelate-aminotransferase pathway | GO:0033362
- [ ] 11. L-arginine biosynthetic process via N-acetyl-L-citrulline (GO:0170067)
- [ ] 12. L-arginine biosynthetic process via ornithine (GO:0042450)
- [ ] 13. L-proline salvage (GO:0019492)
- [ ] 14. L-alanine biosynthetic process from pyruvate (GO:0019272)
- [ ] 15. glycine biosynthetic process from serine (GO:0019264)
- [ ] 16. glycine biosynthetic process, by transamination of glyoxylate (GO:0019265)
- [ ] 17. L-cysteine biosynthetic process from L-serine (GO:0006535)
- [ ] 18. L-cysteine biosynthetic process via L-cystathionine (GO:0019343)
- [ ] 19. L-cysteine biosynthetic process via S-sulfo-L-cysteine (GO:0019345)
- [ ] 20. L-phenylalanine biosynthetic process from chorismate via L-arogenate (GO:0033586)
- [ ] 21. L-phenylalanine biosynthetic process from chorismate via phenylpyruvate (GO:0033585)
- [ ] 22. L-tyrosine biosynthetic process from chorismate via 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate (GO:0019292)
- [ ] 23. L-tyrosine biosynthetic process from chorismate via L-arogenate (GO:0033584)
- [ ] 24. L-tyrosine biosynthetic process, by oxidation of phenylalanine (GO:0019293)

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31525

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LKtErWZPKYeFm-XRhpewnWXF8vCfJPQuTRaJKH40fhY/edit?usp=sharing

title: Review annotations to proteinogenic amino acid biosynthetic process terms

author: edwong57
source_title: Obsoletion notice: multiple proteinogenic amino acid biosynthetic process terms

author: pgaudet
body:
Hi @edwong57 

It seems many of these terms will just be replaced by their parents, right ?

author: edwong57
body: @pgaudet Yes, they will be replaced by their parent terms. I will fix the spreadsheet for the groups that it is automatically done for.

author: sarach06
body:
Hi,
Thank you very much. I have checked these GO terms and replaced by the parent term in 33 InterPro entries. These changes will be visible in InterPro release 109.0.
Best regards,
Sara
